plat_lead_anya: Quick sync: proposing a compact policy schema for tiered routing + fallback that maps cleanly to ratecard and telemetry. Dropping a short PoC below — looking for operational and billing concerns.

devex_jordan: :eyes: drop the snippet and I can mock console UX.

plat_lead_anya: ```json
{
  "policy_id": "tier-routing-v1",
  "billing_tier": "pro",           // policy-level billing tag (free|pro|enterprise)
  "region_overrides": {
    "eu": { "preferred_variant": "gpt-small-q4" }
  },
  "fallback_variants": [
    { "name": "gpt-base-q8", "weight": 70 },
    { "name": "gpt-small-q4", "weight": 30 }
  ],
  "quota_mode": "soft",         // soft|hard|rate-limit-only
  "soft_limits": { "tokens_per_minute": 20000, "burst_tokens": 3000 }
}
```

infra_miguel: Looks reasonable. One operational ask: how do we ensure fallback variants don't accidentally change billing semantics? If a pro request falls back to a cheaper quantized variant, do we bill lower model rate or keep pro rate?

plat_lead_anya: We planned to keep billing orthogonal to model variant. Policy has billing_tier separate from chosen model. So usage is billed by customer tier, not by runtime variant. Avoid surprising invoices.

minal: Important: enterprise customers expect SLOs. Silent fallback to cheaper model can breach latency guarantees. We should emit an explicit slo_degradation event and surface automatic rollback if fallback rate spikes.

plat_lead_anya: Agree. Router will emit telemetry flags: route_fallback=true and fallback_reason one of {capacity,cost,region}. We'll increment telemetry.routes.fallback_count tagged by tenant_id and reason. Console rule: raise alert if fallback_count > 10 in 5m for enterprise.

qa_zoe: How does quota enforcement interact? Free tier should be soft-limited with token-burst buffer, pro should be soft with escalation, enterprise hard. Example semantics?

plat_lead_anya: Proposal: free=soft (throttle with 10s token leak), pro=soft with per-minute commit + auto-escalate to hard when abuse detected, enterprise=hard (reject + notify). We expose quota_mode enum for admin UI to tweak per-tenant.

devex_jordan: UX note: Console should show effective policy (merged defaults + overrides) and a "simulate request" button that shows route selection, chosen variant, and billing tag. Also show history of recent fallbacks per tenant.

infra_miguel: Implementation note: router must evaluate region override before quota decision to avoid accepting requests that violate local capacity. Pre-check should return a deferred token if capacity uncertain.

plat_lead_anya: Router pre-check flow: 1) check tenant quota & local capacity 2) pick variant and route 3) if fallback chosen due to capacity then tag request metadata {fallback_of: modelX, chosen: modelY, billing_tier: pro}.

opsbot: policy-lint: JSON schema v3 requires field "billing_tier" for every policy. See https://internal/docs/policy-schema.

minal: Telemetry: emit p50/p95 latency, token_cost_estimate, route_score, and fallback_count. We should correlate fallback_rate with p95 spikes and cost-savings to validate the tradeoff.

devex_jordan: :thumbsup: I'll mock console graphs: fallback % by tenant, cost-savings estimate if fallbacks applied, and a toggle to opt-in/out per-plan.

qa_zoe: Tests: add unit tests for routing decision tree with randomized sims across regions and bursts. Add e2e to verify billing tag persists after fallback and that quotas behave per quota_mode.

plat_lead_anya: I'll open a PR with the policy schema + router changes. Tentative rollout: internal canary -> opt-in for pro customers -> enterprise off by default. Target PR by EOW.

infra_miguel: If canary, include telemetry.canary=true on those requests so prod dashboards can filter. Don't pollute SLO dashboards.

plat_lead_anya: Good call. Also adding a changelog note so customers understand billing and fallback behavior.

devex_jordan: Anyone object to me creating console mockups and a small interactive policy simulator? I can wire it to the policy-lint endpoint.

minal: No objection. Also let's add an alert on the ops channel if enterprise fallback_count > threshold.

plat_lead_anya: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will post PR link when ready and pin it to this thread. :sparkles:
